# Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): Open Weights, License, Price and Benchmarks

By Lenka Vojtechova  ·  Updated November 7, 2026  ·  12 min read

AI NewsMistralOpen-Source ModelLLMAI Coding

Thumbnail reading [...] Thumbnail reading 

Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, is a 1-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 49 billion active parameters. Mistral AI released it as a public preview API on October 6, 2026, then shipped an improved final version and the open weights on October 29. It reads text and images, answers in text, and now costs $0.70 per million input tokens. [...] Yes. Mistral released the weights on Hugging Face on October 29, 2026, two days after the date it gave reporters. They cover the improved final model, and come with an NVFP4 checkpoint for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. The licence is the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license, a modified MIT licence.

 

How much does Mistral Large 4 cost?

$0.70 per million input tokens and $2.10 per million output tokens, with cached input at $0.07, since October 29, 2026. The preview listed at $1.36 and $4.18.

results.title: Crédit Agricole partners with Mistral AI on platform
results.content:
On 20 October 2026, Crédit Agricole Artificial Intelligence announced a partnership that involves Mistral in building the group's AI platform, beyond access to its models: an agent for retail banking clients, agentic processes, and cybersecurity, presented as "a major focus". The announcements from BNP Paribas and HSBC, already partners of Mistral, do not mention cybersecurity. The announcement sets no amount, duration, model, or exclusivity.

STStephane Nachez · ·4 min [...] The 20 October release cites three workstreams: a conversational agent for clients of the group's retail banks, the "agentic transformation of key processes", and cybersecurity. Crédit Agricole Artificial Intelligence runs the group's AI foundations. With Mistral's technology, it also plans to adapt large language models to its data and use cases. The release sees this as a way to optimise performance, "and therefore the consumption of computing resources and its environmental impact". [...] The 20 October release gives no amount, no commitment duration, no timeline for the client agent, and cites no particular Mistral model. It also says nothing about any exclusivity. The pattern recalls that observed with Mistral at EDF, BMW, or Airbus: partnerships announced, rarely quantified. The announcement comes six weeks after the lab's 3 billion euro fundraising.

content.text:
## Recent developments
- **Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk") Release:** Mistral released its flagship 1-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model (roughly 49–52 billion active parameters) [1, 2, 7]. Following an October public preview, open weights were published on Hugging Face on October 29, 2026, under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License (a modified MIT license) [1, 2]. The model is targeted at agentic coding and sovereign cybersecurity workflows, featuring an NVFP4 checkpoint for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs [1, 2, 9]. API pricing is set at $0.70 per million input tokens and $2.10 per million output tokens [2].
- **Voxtral 3 Speech Family:** On October 20, 2026, Mistral launched Voxtral 3, a suite of four specialized speech-to-text and text-to-speech models (including batch, streaming, and transcription-reasoning variants) alongside a real-time voice agent SDK [6].
- **Strategic Enterprise Partnerships:** 
  - Crédit Agricole Artificial Intelligence announced a partnership with Mistral on October 20, 2026, focusing on retail banking agents, agentic processes, and cybersecurity [3].
  - Orange Cyberdefense joined as a design partner for cybersecurity, planning to integrate Mistral Large 4 into penetration testing and incident response services [4].
  - Mistral partnered with NVIDIA on October 21, 2026, to pair Mistral Large 4 with simulation and physics pipelines for industrial engineering workflows [1].
- **Sovereign Infrastructure & Funding Momentum:** Building on its recent €3 billion Series D funding round in September 2026 (pushing its post-money valuation past €21 billion), Mistral is expanding regional inference and sovereign cloud offerings, including integrations with SAP Business AI and infrastructure build-outs utilizing NVIDIA chips [7, 8].

## Talking points
- **Sovereign Frontier Deployment:** How can Mistral Large 4’s open weights and local deployment options (such as via SAP or NVIDIA stacks) be best leveraged to meet strict data residency and regulatory compliance requirements?
- **Cybersecurity & Agentic Workflows:** With Orange Cyberdefense and Crédit Agricole adopting Mistral Large 4 for threat detection,

penetration testing, and automated processes, what are the primary expansion vectors for agentic applications in enterprise environments [3, 4]?
- **Multimodal & Voice Integration:** How do the newly introduced Voxtral 3 voice capabilities complement multimodal workflows alongside Mistral Large 4 for customer-facing and operational deployments [2, 6]?
- **Ecosystem Licensing:** What practical governance considerations do enterprise legal teams need to review regarding the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License compared to standard open-source licenses [1]?

## Open questions
- What is the anticipated timeline and feature scope for the fully sovereign version of Mistral's platform on SAP Sovereign Cloud planned for early 2027 [8]?
- How will the partnership models with major financial institutions (like Crédit Agricole) scale into long-term commercial commitments and quantified deployment timelines [3]?
- Are there further optimization checkpoints planned for the NVFP4 model weights to maximize efficiency across non-Blackwell hardware architectures [2]?

## Sources

Following an October public preview, open weights were published on Hugging Face on October 29, 2026, under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License (a modified MIT license) [1, 2]. API pricing is set at $0.70 per million input tokens and $2.10 per million output tokens [2].
- **Voxtral 3 Speech Family:** On October 20, 2026, Mistral launched Voxtral 3, a suite of four specialized speech-to-text and text-to-speech models (including batch, streaming, and transcription-reasoning variants) alongside a real-time voice agent SDK [6].

  - Mistral partnered with NVIDIA on October 21, 2026, to pair Mistral Large 4 with simulation and physics pipelines for industrial engineering workflows [1].
